configuration-download-backup-done: Backup IPC.config downloaded. Prefer Apply network settings when the plugin is available.
configuration-download-done-friendly: Network settings file downloaded (no password inside). Put IPC.config in /config and restart ASF. Save the password with the other button if you have not yet.
configuration-finish-1-text: This stores the password in ASF (not in IPC.config) and restarts ASF.
configuration-finish-2-plugin-text: Writes config/IPC.config on the ASF machine via the IpcConfig plugin (no manual copy).
configuration-finish-2-text: IPC.config only has network settings (listen address and allowed ranges). It never includes the password.
configuration-finish-3-text: Copy it to /config (next to the ASF executable).
configuration-finish-4-lan: Restart ASF so other devices on your network can open the panel.
configuration-finish-4-local: Restart ASF, or delete that file later if you want the default “this PC only” behavior.
configuration-finish-4-plugin: With ConfigWatch (default), Kestrel reloads after Apply. Use Restart only if the panel does not come back.
configuration-finish-help: Two separate things: the password is saved with the blue button; the network file is only for who can reach the panel.
configuration-lead-friendly: Choose who can open this panel, set a password, and download a small settings file for ASF.
configuration-lead-plugin: Choose who can open this panel, set a password, and apply network settings directly through the IpcConfig plugin.
configuration-mode-lan-help: Other phones, tablets, or PCs on the same Wi‑Fi can open this panel.
configuration-mode-local-help: Safest option. The panel stays on this PC.
configuration-password-clear-friendly: Remove the password (only when using this computer)
configuration-password-lan-friendly: If other devices can reach this panel, you need a password.
configuration-password-lan-missing-frien: Choose a password before allowing access from the network.
configuration-password-placeholder: Leave empty to keep the current password
configuration-password-unset-friendly: No password yet. Add one if you open the panel to the network.
configuration-plugin-install-limit: ASF cannot install a new plugin automatically from the panel (security). Download → extract → restart is required once; later updates can use ASF plugin update if the plugin is already loaded.
configuration-plugin-missing-text: Without IpcConfig, this page can only download IPC.config for you to copy by hand. Install the plugin to apply network settings from the browser.
configuration-plugin-ready: IpcConfig plugin is loaded. You can apply network settings from this page.
configuration-plugin-step-1: Download {zip} (or the latest release) from GitHub.
configuration-plugin-step-2: Extract into {path} next to ArchiSteamFarm.exe (create the folder if needed).
configuration-plugin-step-3: Restart ASF, then reopen this page.
